text:
{
  "pros": [
    "Extremely comprehensive features, making it an 'all-in-one' solution",
    "Customization for workflows is intuitive and powerful, even on free plans",
    "Consolidates many tools, reducing tool sprawl and cost",
    "Powerful for complex project management and task tracking",
    "Good value for money, especially for the breadth of features",
    "Strong collaboration tools for team communication"
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Steep learning curve due to overwhelming number of features and options",
    "Can be slow, buggy, or suffer from performance issues",
    "Interface can be cluttered and confusing, especially with default elements",
    "Notifications can be overwhelming and difficult to manage",
    "Mobile app often lacks full functionality and can be clunky",
    "Pricing can become expensive for larger teams needing advanced features"
  ],
  "changed": [
    "Pro 2: 'High level of customization and flexibility for various workflows' replaced with 'Customization for workflows is intuitive and powerful, even on free plans' based on the note '[benefit] The + at the end of the list header opened a Fields panel where Dropdown was the first popular type, and a 'Priority' field with High/Low options was created in four actions on the free plan.' This highlights the ease and power of customization specifically shown in the demo.",
    "Con 3: 'Overly complex and clunky interface for new users' replaced with 'Interface can be cluttered and confusing, especially with default elements' based on the note '[friction] A Brain AI chat panel opened by default and took about a third of the screen, which squeezed the list so task names and the custom field column were truncated.' This provides a more specific and direct reason for interface complexity related to default elements rather than just general clunkiness."
  ]
}

pros: Extremely comprehensive features, making it an 'all-in-one' solution
Customization for workflows is intuitive and powerful, even on free plans
Consolidates many tools, reducing tool sprawl and cost
Powerful for complex project management and task tracking
Good value for money, especially for the breadth of features
Strong collaboration tools for team communication
cons: Steep learning curve due to overwhelming number of features and options
Can be slow, buggy, or suffer from performance issues
Interface can be cluttered and confusing, especially with default elements
Notifications can be overwhelming and difficult to manage
Mobile app often lacks full functionality and can be clunky
Pricing can become expensive for larger teams needing advanced features
changed: Pro 2: 'High level of customization and flexibility for various workflows' replaced with 'Customization for workflows is intuitive and powerful, even on free plans' based on the note '[benefit] The + at the end of the list header opened a Fields panel where Dropdown was the first popular type, and a 'Priority' field with High/Low options was created in four actions on the free plan.' This highlights the ease and power of customization specifically shown in the demo.

Con 3: 'Overly complex and clunky interface for new users' replaced with 'Interface can be cluttered and confusing, especially with default elements' based on the note '[friction] A Brain AI chat panel opened by default and took about a third of the screen, which squeezed the list so task names and the custom field column were truncated.' This provides a more specific and direct reason for interface complexity related to default elements rather than just general clunkiness.
